events.continuity_hook: This begins Erin's next clinic-training trip after the Kansas City week closes with the calmer Friday return.
events.interaction_goal: Build a ranked Tennessee plan for arrival timing, flight routing, hotel area, rental-car size, shipment handling, and the decision points to settle before booking.
events.scenario_brief: After returning from Kansas City and finishing the expense notes, Erin is assigned a late-April diagnostics rollout around Middle Tennessee. A Monday afternoon calibration in Franklin is likely but not final, with Tuesday training in Murfreesboro, a Wednesday walkthrough in Nashville, and a Thursday lab day in Hendersonville. A Monday afternoon Denver-to-Nashville nonstop could work if the calibration stays virtual, but a Sunday afternoon arrival gives her time for rental pickup, kit sorting, and a calm start if Monday becomes in-person. She will have a demo laptop case and two workbook cartons, so a compact SUV and easy hotel parking matter. Hotel areas under consideration include a Franklin suite property with strong guest scores, free parking, pool, hot tub, and fitness room; a downtown Nashville hotel closer to the Wednesday site but with paid parking; and an airport hotel that simplifies arrival but adds cross-town drives. The clinic order, Monday format, shipment destination, and return day remain open.

events.continuity_hook: This narrows the Tennessee plan once the Monday calibration and clinic sequence become firm.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the outbound flight, hotel hold, rental car, return-day choice, room notes, shipment plan, and seat requests before fares move.
events.scenario_brief: The coordinator confirms an in-person Monday 3:30 p.m. calibration in Franklin, Tuesday morning training in Murfreesboro, a Wednesday Nashville site visit, and a Thursday Hendersonville workshop expected to end by 2:00 p.m. The Sunday afternoon Denver-to-Nashville nonstop now fits better than a Monday arrival, and the compact SUV is still the practical choice for the demo case and cartons. The Franklin suite hotel can hold a quiet king room with a fridge, free parking, pool, hot tub, and fitness room. The open choice is whether to keep the return on Thursday evening after pack-up or add one more night and take a Friday morning nonstop with less pressure.

events.continuity_hook: This closes the Tennessee planning after Erin chose the extra hotel night and the calmer Friday return.
events.interaction_goal: Run the final logistics pass for airport timing, rental pickup, storm buffers, shipment tracking, checked consumables, hotel arrival, seat selection, and Friday checkout.
events.scenario_brief: Four days before departing for Tennessee, Erin has the Sunday afternoon nonstop, Franklin suite hotel through Friday checkout, compact SUV, and Friday morning return booked. The airline moved the outbound about 30 minutes later, but arrival still leaves time for hotel check-in and Monday calibration prep. The hotel verifies the quiet-room note, fridge, free parking, pool, hot tub, and fitness access. One workbook carton is due at the hotel Monday, the second is now tracking for Wednesday, and the Murfreesboro site asks her to carry a small consumables kit in her checked bag. Spring thunderstorms could slow Monday and Wednesday drives, and an aircraft swap removed the return window-seat assignment.

events.continuity_hook: This shifts from Erin's spring work rollouts into a fixed-date family trip where schedule matters more than her usual flexibility.
events.interaction_goal: Compare flight dates, connection burden, beach versus relatives-area hotels, rental-car need, room comfort, and a booking path that protects the family schedule.
events.scenario_brief: After the Tennessee trip, Erin starts planning a June family weekend in the Norfolk and Virginia Beach area with her spouse. The family picnic is fixed for Saturday afternoon and brunch is planned for Sunday morning, so they are comparing a Friday arrival against flying in Thursday night to avoid a rushed start. Denver-to-Norfolk options include a cleaner one-stop routing with a manageable layover, a later Friday itinerary with a longer connection, and a Thursday evening arrival that adds a hotel night. Hotel choices include an oceanfront property within an easy walk of the boardwalk with balcony-request rooms, pool, and fitness room but no hot tub; a Chesapeake business hotel closer to relatives with easier parking; and an airport hotel that works only if they arrive late. The travel dates, hotel area, rental car, and how much to stretch the weekend budget are unresolved.

events.continuity_hook: This follows the first Virginia Beach planning pass after the family meal times make the arrival day less flexible.
events.interaction_goal: Settle the Thursday arrival, choose the oceanfront versus Chesapeake hotel, book the flights and rental car, request window seats, and note the hotel amenity trade-offs.
events.scenario_brief: Erin's sister confirms Friday dinner at 6:00 p.m. and Sunday brunch at 10:00 a.m., making a Friday afternoon arrival too tight. The best fit is now a Thursday evening Denver departure with one short connection and a Monday midday return, while a Friday morning option would require a pre-dawn start and still leave little margin if the connection slips. The oceanfront hotel can offer a cancellable king room with a strong guest score, pool, fitness access, and a balcony request, but the hot tub is absent and parking is extra. The Chesapeake hotel is cheaper and easier for family visits but would mean giving up the beach stay they want for the weekend. The remaining decisions are whether the added Thursday hotel night is worth it and whether to book a compact or midsize rental for luggage and family errands.

events.continuity_hook: This closes the family-weekend plan after Erin chose the extra Thursday night to make Friday dinner and the beach stay easier.
events.interaction_goal: Run the final check for connection timing, airport arrival, seat cleanup, hotel parking strategy, balcony request, weather backup, rental pickup, and Monday return timing.
events.scenario_brief: Six days before the Virginia Beach family weekend, Erin and her spouse have the Thursday evening one-stop outbound, Monday midday return, oceanfront hotel, and midsize rental booked. The airline has moved the outbound connection from 75 minutes to just under an hour, which is still workable but leaves less cushion for a delayed Denver departure. The hotel confirms the pool and fitness room, says the balcony remains request-only, and notes that parking is first-come in the main garage during a beach festival weekend. A coastal rain forecast may affect the Saturday picnic, and the return aircraft swap separated their seat assignments with only one window still available.
